HTTP::release
Description
Releases the data collected via
HTTP::collect
. Unless a subsequent
HTTP::collect
command was issued, there is no
need to use the
HTTP::release
command inside of the
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
and
HTTP_RESPONSE_DATA
events, since (in
these cases) the data is implicitly released.
It is important to note that these semantics are different than those
of the
TCP::collect
and
TCP::release
commands. With
TCP::collect
, the event for processing the
data (
CLIENT_DATA
) will fire without
TCP::release
being called, whereas with
HTTP::collect
, the event
(
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
or
HTTP_RESPONSE_DATA
) will not fire
without
HTTP::release
being called (at least implicitly).
Syntax
HTTP
::
release
HTTP::release
Releases the collected data.
